summary.text: Donna Henderson is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 15 (Calvin) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Donna Henderson's service as "House since 2023". The member page lists Donna Henderson's committee assignments as including the Agriculture and the Judiciary standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Donna Henderson's occupation as Farm wife; Retired Dental Hygienist.
It lists education as AS, NDSCS.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: Secretary, Cavalier County Farm Bureau.
Donna Henderson is listed as married to Paul with 6 children and 9 grandchildren.
